data.original_title: Last Call at the Blue Room
data.overview: A nightclub owner plans to leave his violent past behind, but a masked robbery draws rival cartels toward his door. A mysterious buyer offers an exit that may be another trap, forcing him to navigate shifting loyalties before the club becomes a battleground.
data.tagline: The night has one more surprise.
